inMemoryDataStructures.purpose: High-speed in-memory cache of multi-provider live scores board
inMemoryDataStructures.risk: Ephemeral. Only contains currently active/live fixtures returned by upstream feeds. When a match ends, it drops from this cache.

inMemoryDataStructures.purpose: State engine for live matches in memory
Short TTL (2,000ms) cache for odds payloads
inMemoryDataStructures.risk: Cache only. Not used for identity truth.

remediation: In-memory maps are used strictly as Level 1 acceleration caches. PostgreSQL persistence (matches table, placement snapshots, and match_over_snapshots) now serves as the permanent backing store for all placed-bet matches.
